import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Modular {
        int val;

        Modular() { val = 0; }
        Modular(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }
        Modular(long v) {
            val = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        Modular add(Modular other) {
            int res = val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new Modular(res);
        }
        Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            int res = val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new Modular(res);
        }
        Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            long res = (long)val * other.val % MOD;
            return new Modular((int)res);
        }
        Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return multiply(other.inv());
        }
        Modular negate() {
            return new Modular(val == 0 ? 0 : MOD - val);
        }

        Modular pow(long p) {
            Modular a = this;
            Modular ans = new Modular(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) ans = ans.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return ans;
        }

        Modular inv() {
            int a = val, b = MOD;
            int ax = 1, bx = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                int q = a / b;
                int t = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = t;
                t = ax - bx * q;
                ax = bx;
                bx = t;
            }
            assert a == 1;
            if (ax < 0) ax += MOD;
            return new Modular(ax);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Modular modular = (Modular) o;
            return val == modular.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int number = scanner.nextInt();
        Modular[] probability = new Modular[number * number];
        for (int i = 0; i < number * number; i++) {
            int percentage = scanner.nextInt();
            probability[i] = new Modular(1).divide(new Modular(100)).multiply(new Modular(percentage));
        }

        int middle = number / 2;
        int[] maskValue = new int[1 << 6];
        int count = 0;
        for (int matchMask = 0; matchMask < (1 << 6); matchMask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(matchMask) == middle) {
                maskValue[matchMask] = count++;
            } else {
                maskValue[matchMask] = -1;
            }
        }
        Modular[] total = new Modular[1 << count];
        for (int i = 0; i < total.length; i++) total[i] = new Modular(0);

        // process left half
        process(0, middle, number, probability, maskValue, total, (sets, prob) -> {
            total[sets] = total[sets].add(prob);
        });

        // subset sum over total
        for (int dim = 1; dim < total.length; dim <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total.length; i++) {
                if ((i & dim) == 0) {
                    total[i | dim] = total[i | dim].add(total[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        Modular result = new Modular(0);
        // process right half
        process(middle, number, number, probability, maskValue, total, (sets, prob) -> {
            result = result.add(prob.multiply(total[total.length - 1].subtract(total[total.length - 1 - sets])));
        });

        System.out.println((int)result.val);
    }

    static void process(int left, int right, int number, Modular[] probability, int[] maskValue, Modular[] total, java.util.function.BiConsumer<Integer, Modular> handle) {
        int len = right - left;
        int edgeMaskLimit = 1 << (len * number);
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < edgeMaskLimit; edgeMask++) {
            Modular totalProbability = new Modular(1);
            boolean skip = false;
            for (int tmp = edgeMask, i = left * number; i < right * number; i++, tmp >>= 1) {
                if ((tmp & 1) == 1) {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.multiply(probability[i]);
                } else {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.multiply(new Modular(1).subtract(probability[i]));
                }
                if (totalProbability.val == 0) {
                    skip = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (skip) continue;

            int matchSets = 0;
            int[] data = new int[len];
            outer:
            while (true) {
                int matchMask = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < len; index++) {
                    int bitPos = index * number + data[index];
                    if ((edgeMask >> bitPos & 1) == 0) {
                        // go to next data combination
                        for (int i = len - 1; ; i--) {
                            if (i < 0) break outer;
                            if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                                data[i] = 0;
                            } else {
                                data[i]++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        // continue outer loop with new data
                        continue outer;
                    }
                    if ((matchMask & (1 << data[index])) != 0) {
                        // go to next data combination
                        for (int i = len - 1; ; i--) {
                            if (i < 0) break outer;
                            if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                                data[i] = 0;
                            } else {
                                data[i]++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        continue outer;
                    }
                    matchMask |= 1 << data[index];
                }
                if (right == number) {
                    matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                }
                int idx = maskValue[matchMask];
                if (idx != -1) {
                    matchSets |= 1 << idx;
                }

                // increase data
                for (int i = len - 1; ; i--) {
                    if (i < 0) break outer;
                    if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                        data[i] = 0;
                    } else {
                        data[i]++;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            handle.accept(matchSets, totalProbability);
        }
    }
}
